environment: go1.24.1 darwin/arm64; live network reads against huggingface.co, modelscope.cn and gitee.com
scope: The happy path was executed for real: weightcanary init wrote the pre-filled watchlist, weightcanary watch snapshotted the three default models across Hugging Face and ModelScope (and Gitee where the anonymous API budget allowed) and wrote state.json.
The full run took about 43 seconds end to end (the Gitee poller spaces its requests to stay under the anonymous rate limit).
The divergence numbers below come from comparing the live HF and ModelScope listings within one run; they will drift as the registries change, which is the point of the tool.

output_summary.huggingface: all three repos present; per-file size and lfs sha256 recorded
output_summary.modelscope: all three mirrors present; HF-vs-ModelScope divergence computed from file set + size + lfs sha256
output_summary.gitee: the anonymous Gitee API budget was exhausted earlier the same hour, so the mirror rows surface the rate limit as an error instead of a fake result; with GITEE_TOKEN or a fresh window these rows complete
output_summary.deepseek_divergence_detail: .gitattributes 1519->2127 bytes, LICENSE 1084->1064, README.md 11340->11296, plus one mirror-only configuration.json — the weight shards and their LFS sha256 match exactly. Same-size files that ModelScope stores as LFS while HF keeps as plain git (tokenizer.json, the weight index) are deliberately not counted as divergence.
output_summary.state_json: state.json written (~175 KiB, one AvailabilityRecord per model with per-file size and lfs_sha256), suitable for git commit as the audit ledger

not_executed.feature: change alerts (takedown / mirror-divergence notifications via Feishu, DingTalk, generic webhook)
not_executed.note: v0.1 is the m1 milestone: snapshot + report + state.json ledger. The run-to-run diff engine and the notifiers are stubs (internal/diff, internal/notify) and their Feishu/DingTalk card payloads are unverified until a live bot send confirms them.

limitations: Anonymous Gitee API calls are aggressively rate-limited; decoding the LFS pointers of a large mirror (over a hundred weight shards) can exhaust the budget mid-run. The poller spaces and backs off its requests, marks incomplete listings as partial, and surfaces hard rate limits as error rows — it never presents a half-checked mirror as divergent. Set GITEE_TOKEN for reliable full runs.

ModelScope does not expose a repo-level commit sha through the public files endpoint, so mirror freshness is judged by file set + size + lfs sha256, not by commit gating (Hugging Face rows do carry the commit sha).
Hugging Face answers HTTP 401, not 404, for missing or gated repos; both are reported as absent. Set HF_TOKEN to watch gated repos you have access to.

The HF API poller talks to huggingface.co directly. hf-mirror.com only mirrors the /resolve/ download URLs (its /api/* is geo-dependently redirected) and is therefore not usable as an API fallback; that behavior is geo-dependent and was not verified in this build.
Feishu/DingTalk alert card payloads are unverified in v0.1 (they need real bot tokens to confirm); alert delivery itself lands with the m2 milestone.
Only file presence, size and lfs sha256 are compared. Weight bytes are never downloaded; WeightCanary monitors, it does not mirror.
